en: A vintage monochrome postcard-style illustration showing an electric tram or train travelling over an elevated viaduct through a wooded, hilly area. The bridge has high arches and railings, with tall catenary poles carrying overhead wires for the tram. On the right is a road and parapet with countryside and distant flat landscape beyond. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin in Dutch.
